headline.purpose: Event identity and primary workspace headings.

body.purpose: Controls, tables, supporting copy, and metadata.

motion.name: overlay-navigation-displacement
motion.purpose: Moves the navigation above the viewport while a portal overlay is active, preserving its layout space.

motion.name: preview-sheet-transition
motion.purpose: Shared transition for the page-scale preview sheet and its dimming overlay.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); font: 600 14px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px hsl(var(--primary) / .16); transition: color 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--primary)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A base-scale field with emerald focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 12px; background: hsl(var(--card)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: hsl(var(--primary)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px hsl(var(--primary) / .12); }

components.name: Workspace Card
components.description: A connected operational panel with base-scale structure.
components.css: .ds-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 16px; background: hsl(var(--card)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgb(6 17 12 / .06); } .ds-card header { padding: 16px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); } .ds-card > div { padding: 20px; }

narrative.overview: EventPass is a calm, precise operations product built from cool green-neutral surfaces and one vivid emerald accent. The shared top navigation begins flat and condenses into a floating pill as content scrolls beneath it.
keyCharacteristics: Emerald Cyber palettes are the single color source.
A shared top navigation replaces the previous persistent side rail.
Flat modular panels use crisp dividers and restrained elevation.
Gentle motion explains navigation and state continuity.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Emerald owns routine action, selection, progress, focus, and important state.

rules.name: The Palette Source Rule
rules.body: New colors derive from the Emerald Cyber base, brand, or alert scales.

rules.name: The Shared Frame Rule
rules.body: Dashboard and administration routes use one top navigation and shared Tamagui surface primitives.

rules.name: The Single Event Context Rule
rules.body: Event-scoped dashboard workspaces resolve their selected event from the global navigation's eventId URL context and do not repeat a local event selector.

rules.name: The Structure-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Fill, border, spacing, and typography establish hierarchy before elevation.

rules.name: The Clear Overlay Stage Rule
rules.body: Every portal overlay displaces the shared navigation through the same coordinated transition without collapsing its reserved layout space.

rules.name: The One Preview Plane Rule
rules.body: Page-scale previews use the shared 92%-height bottom sheet at every viewport; they do not switch to a centered dialog on wide screens.

dos: Do use the Emerald Cyber Tamagui palettes as the single color source.
Do preserve the centered organization home control and leading event selector.
Do let the global navigation own event context for event-scoped dashboard workspaces.
Do displace the navigation with the shared 420ms transition whenever a portal overlay is active.
Do use the shared 92%-height bottom sheet for page-scale previews on every viewport.
Do keep controls accessible and motion gentle.
donts: Don't revive legacy warm or page-specific palettes.
Don't add a persistent left navigation rail.
Don't use gradients or unrelated semantic color families.
